dates.display: twenty-acre lot recorded from the town's earliest purchaser list (post-15 May 1667 incorporation) through its sale to Josiah Thayer, 3 May 1692

outgoing.explanation: John Gurny's Mendon lot and 1692 sale is one of the two lot-holder records synthesized.

shortLabel: Mendon Proprietors' Records: John Gurny's 20-acre lot, sold 1692

sources.locator: pp. 13, 152-153, and recurring abuttal references at pp. 29, 84, 109, 159, 185, 211, 340-341, 346, 350, 373, 462: John Gurny's twenty-acre lot and its 1692 sale to Josiah Thayer.

statement: The Mendon proprietors' records list "John Gurny, a twenty acre lot" among the town's earliest purchasers, and trace the same lot's chain of title through recurring meadow and swamp-lot abuttal references to its sale, by deed of 3 May 1692, to Josiah Thayer.
